name: Cu Chi veal
summary: Local veal. The Ho Chi Minh City Tourism Promotion Center says it is prepared into various dishes and names none. Tuổi Trẻ says the meat is fine-grained and red, from animals about 5–6 months old, on the word of unnamed chefs.
origin: Củ Chi. The tourism center calls it local veal. Người Lao Động says farms raise the cattle on a grass of this district. Tuổi Trẻ says cattle raised in Củ Chi.
howToEat: The tourism center says the veal is prepared into various dishes and names none. The plates other publishers name are separate.
Tuổi Trẻ, on 25 Jun 2018, says unnamed chefs choose healthy animals of about 5–6 months. That age is one account.

taste: The tourism center says tender and flavorful and does not go further. Tuổi Trẻ says a mild sweetness, a fine grain, and a fresh red color. Người Lao Động says the meat is soft and fragrant.
